name: Creative & Offer
focus: Multi-SKU merchandising, offer architecture and conversion creative
summary: Material update: Muda Cero remains HERO but the current 3-piece supplier path is too tight to treat as launch-ready; add a gated 2-piece grooming-core contingency, keep the hard-bottom dog cover as second HERO with fit-first positioning, demote windshield umbrella to seasonal CROSS-SELL, and keep packing cubes as TEST only.
blocker: Full Muda Cero economics/fulfillment remain unresolved; exact EU hard-bottom dog-cover SKU is still missing; third collection lacks enough validated depth for launch prominence.
material_change_reason: Supplier economics and competitor/ads evidence materially change the offer hierarchy.

ugc_concepts.muda_cero: 15-20s real pet + real textile; map one tool to one job and end with visible collected hair.
ugc_concepts.dog_cover: 20-30s real car; measure seat, install exact SKU, show rigid platform, belt/seat fit and realistic dog use.
ugc_concepts.packing_cubes: Fixed clothing list, same carry-on, exact before/after closure and thickness.
ugc_concepts.sunshade: Real deployment, dimensions and mirror/dashboard clearance; seasonal supporting creative only.

bundle_hypotheses.name: Muda Cero grooming core
bundle_hypotheses.gate: contingency only; Finance must model and copy must narrow to grooming/prevention

homepage_order: third-category teaser only after depth threshold
merchandising_map.rule: Do not give above-the-fold space to low-confidence TEST products; do not expose a public collection until it has at least 3 credible SKUs or 1 HERO + 2 coherent complements.

store_builder: Keep three-category architecture but visually prioritize only collections with validated HERO/CORE depth.
Add validation state so TEST/CROSS-SELL candidates cannot render as launch-ready by accident.
Build Muda Cero modularly: full 3-step HERO plus hidden contingency CORE variant that can be activated only after Finance/fulfillment approval.
Dog-cover PDP must lead with dimensions/fit and structural proof; 3D only if it explains geometry of the exact SKU.
Seasonal windshield umbrella must never receive homepage HERO treatment.
seo_catalog: Prioritize pet hair removal/dog grooming at home and dog car protection/pet travel.
Do not build a windshield-sunshade SEO cluster yet.
Keep TEST-only PDPs noindex until product/economic gates clear.
Muda Cero FAQ: coat type, textile compatibility, safe brushing, tool-to-job mapping.
Dog-cover FAQ: exact dimensions, how to measure, belt access, waterproofing, washing, explicit non-crash-safety wording.
finance: Model 2-piece Muda Cero grooming-core contingency at 34.90 and 29.90 only as a fallback.
Current packing-cube supplier should not be treated as paid-acquisition viable without materially better landed cost.

events.title: Portfolio architecture changed
events.detail: Creative moved from one-product merchandising to three adjacent job-led collections so the store can scale toward 20–50 SKUs without looking like a bazaar.

events.title: Muda Cero pricing order changed
events.detail: Competitor benchmarks support testing €39.90 first, €34.90 second; €29.90 remains acquisition-only pending Finance.

events.title: Second HERO narrowed
events.detail: Generic dog hammocks are rejected; only a hard-bottom/backseat-extender version should advance as a HERO candidate.

events.title: Muda Cero offer architecture gated
events.detail: Current 3-piece sourcing is too tight for launch confidence; full system stays HERO concept but a 2-piece grooming-core contingency is added for Finance modeling.

events.title: Commodity shelf demoted
events.detail: Windshield umbrella moves to seasonal CROSS-SELL and packing cubes remain TEST only; neither receives HERO or paid-acquisition priority.

events.title: Dog-cover story changed to fit proof
events.detail: Hard-bottom alone is no longer enough differentiation; exact dimensions, measurement UX and structural proof become the merchandising spine.
